findings: All 16 outputs depict adult male priest-like subjects with visible clerical collars and no hats.
Most faces share similar dark hair and facial structure; some facial hair, complexion and apparent age variation exists.
Seed 20012 has severe ghosted eye/glasses artifacts and displaced lower-face details. Seeds 20003 and 20009 have visible mouth/cheek deformation.
Several other samples have blurry or poorly resolved eye details at native256; this does not meet the requested1024-like photographic quality.
Distinct byte hashes and LPIPS distances do not establish distinct identities or acceptable anatomy.
decision: Reject production promotion; continue bounded experiment and separate source-preserving data research.
